method: Read all 191 category rows and all168 distinct scene labels in source and translation, checked duplicate targets for erased distinctions, compared existing glossary spellings. No draft edits.

corrections.reason: Locked character glossary uses Berkt, not Belkt. Temp category should retain Tube to distinguish a launcher from a projectile; Torp. preserves torpedo meaning in compact display.
Use locked project spelling from terms_028, which already labels this same Overman Rushrod.

uncertainties.concern: Display loses launcher/tube distinction, while full_en correctly says Original Allied Ship Missile Tube (Temporary Name).
uncertainties.suggestion: Prefer Ally Msl. Tube (Temp.) if this fits. Original is a development placeholder descriptor, so retaining Temp. without Original is reasonable in the narrow display.

uncertainties.concern: Full source specifically says superlarge. NF is acceptable for New Federation.
uncertainties.suggestion: Consider NF Superheavy Transp. if it fits; full_en already preserves Superheavy Transport Aircraft.

uncertainties.concern: Risnir, Tannthor, Thiassi, Septin, and Clade remain provisional game-original spellings. Kana supports multiple Roman spellings; no stronger primary English evidence was inspected in this bounded review. Retain explicit provisional status.

accepted_decisions: Temporary-name markers retained for all developer placeholders; did not turn them into invented canonical names.
Tracked Cannon normalizes apparent source typos in the tracked-vehicle term; scene form uses correct track spelling.
All subtype A/B/C, size S/M/L, vehicle modes, and Invader qualifiers remain distinct.
Hikaru represents two separate Japanese name strings belonging to different people; shared English short name is valid and not a mapping error.
Focker and Kashmir match character_names_021 even where other familiar franchise spellings exist.
Jovian Destroyer, Picket Ship, Heavy Attack Craft, Transport Patrol Craft, Fast Space Boat, MLRS, Satellite Cannon, Missile Ship, and Train accurately classify generic source units.
Clop/Musaka Light Cruiser and Tenzan Land Battleship omit only the recoverable class suffix in narrow display; full_en preserves it.
Antibody Coralian size suffixes and Gundam variant abbreviations have full_en expansions and do not merge distinct entries.
Original Allied Ship Laser Cannon abbreviated Allied Ship Laser in scene labels preserves the weapon class sufficiently.
scope_limits: No modifications to map_names_036.json or its glossary.
Proper-name corrections should be applied by parent after meaning review, per BASE_RULES.
